sentences.en: You can rely on him. He never lets you down.
sentences.zh: 你可以信赖他。他从不让你失望。

sentences.en: I'll rely on my father for half of my tuition.
sentences.zh: 我将靠父亲资助我一半学费。

sentences.en: It is questionable whether this data can be relied on.
sentences.zh: 这数据是否可靠值得怀疑。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：re（一再）+ly（音似：“lie”撒谎）→又撒谎了，不值得信赖→信赖
